chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"Acts of kindness protect against evil downfalls."

key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: recognized goodness, kindness, and virtuous conduct
key_terms.صَنَائِعُ: deeds or acts that are deliberately carried out
key_terms.مَصَارِعَ: downfalls, fatal outcomes, or ruinous ends

ai.seo_question: How do acts of kindness protect a person from harm according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that doing good to others has a protective effect in a person's life. It emphasizes the ethical value of benevolence and presents good deeds as a means of warding off destructive outcomes.
